hebrewText: וְ/כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֞ל שָׁמְע֣וּ לֵ/אמֹ֗ר הִכָּ֤ה שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת נְצִ֣יב פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וְ/גַם נִבְאַשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּ/פְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וַ/יִּצָּעֲק֥וּ הָ/עָ֛ם אַחֲרֵ֥י שָׁא֖וּל הַ/גִּלְגָּֽל

tokens.bdb: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
tokens.kjv: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
tokens.explanation: kol — todo, toda, qualquer, totalidade de algo

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] attentively, call (gather) together, [idiom] carefully, [idiom] certainly, consent, consider, be content, declare, [idiom] diligently, discern, give ear, (cause to, let, make to) hear(-ken, tell), [idiom] indeed, listen, make (a) noise, (be) obedient, obey, perceive, (make a) proclaim(-ation), publish, regard, report, shew (forth), (make a) sound, [idiom] surely, tell, understand, whosoever (heareth), witness.
tokens.enLiteralWord: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention
tokens.explanation: shama — ouvir, escutar, obedecer, prestar atenção
tokens.explanationEn: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention

tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.

tokens.bdb: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: beat, cast forth, clap, give (wounds), [idiom] go forward, [idiom] indeed, kill, make (slaughter), murderer, punish, slaughter, slay(-er, -ing), smite(-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, [idiom] surely, wound.

tokens.bdb: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: something stationary, i.e. a prefect, a military post, a statue
a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanation: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanationEn: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

tokens.bdb: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
tokens.kjv: again, alike, also, (so much) as (soon), both (so)...and, but, either...or, even, for all, (in) likewise (manner), moreover, nay...neither, one, then(-refore), though, what, with, yea.

tokens.bdb: to smell bad; figuratively, to be offensive morally
tokens.kjv: (make to) be abhorred (had in abomination, loathsome, odious), (cause a, make to) stink(-ing savour), [idiom] utterly.

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)

tokens.bdb: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.enLiteralWord: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanation: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth
tokens.explanationEn: a Pelishtite or inhabitant of Pelesheth

tokens.bdb: to shriek; (by implication) to proclaim (an assembly)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] at all, call together, cry (out), gather (selves) (together).

tokens.bdb: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
tokens.explanation: am — povo, nação, grupo de pessoas com identidade comum

tokens.bdb: properly, the hind part; generally used as an adverb or conjunction, after (in various senses)
tokens.kjv: after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, [phrase] out (over) live, [phrase] persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence(-forth), when, with.
tokens.explanation: achar — depois, após, atrás, em seguida

tokens.bdb: Shaul, the name of an Edomite and two Israelites
Gilgal, the name of three places in Palestine
